jobs.title: Finance, Assistant Finance Manager, Real Estate, 12 month Fixed Term Contract, Based in Frankfurt (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Overview of the Role
- Financial management of development and investment properties located in Europe

- Provide support to the respective Asset & Fund Managers

- Close interaction with other Nuveen Real Estate offices globally and assisting with all finance related reporting requirements

- Hands on involvement with reporting, cash flow management and process improvement

- Support and close collaboration with third party service providers

Main Duties and Responsibilities

Regular :
- Supporting the Fund Team acquiring new assets and managing the existing real estate portfolio

- Liquidity Management and Performance Measurement of the Funds in cooperation with the service-KVG

- Preparing and reviewing reporting to various internal departments (Performance, Treasury, etc.)

- Maintaining relationship with external advisors and service providers (i.e. managing agents, service-KVGs, lenders, due diligence advisors)

- Supporting in clarifying ad-hoc accounting queries with external property and fund accountants

- Develop close working relationship with Fund Manager(s) and Asset Managers

- Close interaction with other Nuveen offices globally and assisting with all reporting requirements

- Liaising with managing agents and members of the wider Nuveen team to deliver process standardisation and efficiencies

Annually :
- Supporting preparation and reviewing of year-end financial statements/ annual reports

- Contact for property and transaction related audit and fund accountant queries

Quarterly/ bi-annually :
- Preparation and reviewing of investor and bank reporting

- Preparation of financial figures for Investor Meetings

- Preparation of finance sections for quarterly investment reports

Monthly :
- Reviewing the monthly reports prepared by the service-KVG

- Liquidity Management and Performance Measurement (ONI-and IRR-Yields) of the Funds in cooperation with the service-KVG

- Update of Investors overviews (shares, investment value, drawn capital, outstanding commitment)

- Loan covenant monitoring

Genera l:
- Supporting interactions with – treasury, fund management, Service-KVG, auditors, managing agents, banks and other 3rd party service providers

- Liaising with all parts of Nuveen as appropriate to ensure that all financial and operational matters are dealt with and managed

Technical Skills & Qualifications Required
- Qualified accountant (ACA/ACCA/CIMA or equivalent like Bilanzbuchhalter IHK or Assistant tax consultant)

- Property and/or Fund experience is desirable

- Good knowledge of Excel, Word, Outlook & accounting systems (Yardi experience desirable but not essential)

- Knowledge of local accounting standards

- Good knowledge in Tax law

- English skills

Competencies Required
- Result and deadline driven - Use own initiative to identify any problems and deliver solutions

- Team player - Close liaison with fund management and other areas of the finance and operations team, as well as external advisers

- Communication & presentation - Clarity of presentation of information to internal and external clients/investors as appropriate

- Teamwork/Commercial - Support the other members of the Finance team and Fund teams

- Act in line with Nuveen Real Estate’s Company Values

- Mature and confident, able to deliver against objectives and to manage internal and client relationships

- Good analytical, planning and organizational skills

- Interested in investment law, real estate funds and transactions

FCA registration required: No
ASIC registration: No

_____________________________________________________________________________________________________

Company Overview

Nuveen is a global investment leader, managing public and private assets for clients around the world and on behalf of TIAA, our parent company and one of the world’s largest institutional investors. We invest in the growth of businesses, real estate, infrastructure and natural capital, providing clients with the reliability, access and foresight unique to our heritage. Our prevailing perspective on the future drives our ambition to innovate and adapt our business to the changing needs of investors - all to pursue lasting performance for our clients, our communities and our global economy. Visit  www.nuveen.com to learn more about us.

jobs.title: Clean Energy Investment Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview
Nuveen is a global investment leader, managing public and private assets for clients around the world and on behalf of TIAA, our parent company and one of the world’s largest institutional investors. We invest in the growth of businesses, real estate, infrastructure and natural capital, providing clients with the reliability, access and foresight unique to our heritage. Our prevailing perspective on the future drives our ambition to innovate and adapt our business to the changing needs of investors - all to pursue lasting performance for our clients, our communities and our global economy. Visit www.nuveen.com to learn more about us.

Overview of the Role:
The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the origination, analysis, and execution of clean energy investments across Europe.

Key responsibilities:
Modelling and investment proposals
- Produce, develop, and review of cash flow based financial models for renewable energy generation projects / assets / platforms valuation
- Understand and optimise the project contractual structures
- Define, document, and monitor all project assumptions
- Understand and analyse project SPV financial statements
- Analyse and interpret results from the financial model, run sensitivities to help with the assessment of the investment case
- Draft investment proposals and investment committee presentations with support and input from Investment Directors
- Support in training Analysts and Associates on developing financial modelling and valuation skills

Transaction support
- Support origination activities with renewable project developers in EU 27 economies and the UK
- Drive and assist in the execution of deals (acquisitions, exits, project financing, divestments)
- Drive due diligence workstreams and project manage transactions and coordinate work products from external advisors (developers / EPC contractors, lawyers, technical advisors, financing providers, etc.) including preparation where applicable of marketing materials
- Develop proprietary pipeline of potential transactions based on a network of contacts, with autonomy from, but transparency to the team

Portfolio management and Value creation
- Sit or support portfolio company boards, monitor KPIs, budgets and strategic plans
- Drive value creation initiatives: growth strategy, M&A, operational improvements, capital structure optimization
- Track ESG/ impacts metrics relevant to energy transition

Market monitoring
- Support in liaising with renewable energy and clean tech organisations
- Conduct research on selected sectors, countries or market segments to identify potential investment opportunities
- Follow regulatory development in the renewable energy sectors (regulatory framework, tariffs, EU targets, etc.

Fund Level Support
- From time to time the role will entail offering support to other teams with Fund level activities.  Such activities may include:
- Production of marketing materials for fund raising campaigns
- Compilation of VDD materials for prospective LPs
- Miscellaneous additional activities associated with business development
- Contribute to fund level reporting, LP communications and valuation processes

Qualifications & Experience Required
Candidates must be competent to build and operate detailed financial models; manage legal, technical, regulatory and commercial due diligence workstreams with appropriate understanding; have significant understanding of the political and environmental relevance of the energy and power sectors.  Prior transaction experience, from working in investment banking, mergers and acquisitions, or private equity experience is required.

- Min. 7 years relevant working experience
- Equity investment experience essential – with demonstrable track record which may come from experience at an investment management firm, investment bank or M&A advisory house, an energy company / utility / IPP, or consultancy
- Significant financial modelling expertise is essential and required
- Experience with platform strategies in energy transition sectors
- Corporate finance or project finance transaction experience (from origination to execution)
- Relevant experience and knowledge of power/energy industry required
- Fluent English required with additional European languages preferred
- International deal experience
- Candidates must have the right to work in the UK
- Demonstrable network of contacts among the universe of project sponsors
- A strong academic background appropriate to the role, however a variety of backgrounds are welcome from: finance, engineering, accounting, legal, or the STEM fields.

Competencies Required
- Excellent communication and written skills
- A strategic approach, sound business judgment and a strong entrepreneurial mind-set is required

Additional Information

This role requires no regulatory designation.
Nuveen is committed to providing equal opportunity across all employment practices and we believe our employees have a right to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

jobs.title: Associate Director - Program Management Expert
jobs.description:
Expert - Program Management - IN
The role will be performing a non-technical project completion using an internal customer perspective, typically from initiation to delivery. They coordinate cross-functional teams through meetings and progress measurement activities which bring distinct, specific projects to completion both on time and within budget.

Key Responsibilities and Duties - This role has project management responsibility

- This job manages specific projects that have a distinct beginning and end. The job requires people and resource management through others; and incumbents are part of cross-functional teams required to complete the project.

Educational Requirements - University (Degree) Preferred

Work Experience - 5+ Years Required; 7+ Years Preferred

Physical Requirements - Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

Career Level
9IC

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Program Manager with 15+ years of experience to lead strategic programs, drive execution, and align cross-functional initiatives within our organization . This role requires a highly experienced leader with a deep understanding of enterprise-scale program management, stakeholder alignment, and business impact delivery . The Senior Program Manager will work closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineering Managers, Software Engineers, and QA teams to ensure seamless collaboration and execution.

Key Responsibilities
1. Strategic Program Leadership
- Lead and oversee multiple high-impact, cross-functional programs that drive business and product success.
- Develop long-term program roadmaps aligned with business and product strategy.
- Act as a trusted advisor to executives and senior leadership , ensuring programs align with company objectives.
- Drive enterprise-wide transformation initiatives , influencing strategic decisions and execution.

2. Executive Stakeholder & Cross-functional Collaboration
- Work directly with C-level executives, VPs, and senior leadership to communicate program status, risks, and opportunities.
- Partner with Product Managers and Product Owners to ensure alignment of business goals with program execution.
- Collaborate with Engineering Leadership to optimize resource planning, technical delivery, and scalability.
- Build strong relationships with key business units to drive alignment and shared accountability.

3. Enterprise Agile & Operational Excellence
- Implement and refine enterprise Agile frameworks (SAFe, Lean Portfolio Management, or similar) to improve efficiency.
- Define and drive standardization of program execution best practices, governance, and reporting mechanisms.
- Establish and continuously refine KPIs and OKRs to measure program effectiveness and impact.
- Drive process improvement initiatives to enhance delivery speed, quality, and cross-team collaboration .

4. Risk Management & Issue Resolution
- Proactively identify enterprise-level risks and dependencies across multiple programs and teams.
- Develop and implement mitigation strategies to ensure business continuity and program success .
- Act as a key escalation point for critical issues, driving resolution with executive stakeholders when needed.

5. Reporting, Analytics & Business Impact
- Provide data-driven insights and executive-level reporting on program performance, risks, and opportunities.
- Leverage advanced analytics to drive decision-making, process optimization, and continuous improvement.
- Align programs with financial, operational, and customer success metrics to drive business value.

6. Leadership & Mentorship
- Serve as a mentor and coach for project and program managers, fostering a high-performance culture.
- Lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, driving collaboration and accountability.
- Champion a culture of execution, innovation, and continuous learning within the organization.

Key Qualifications
- 15+ years of experience in program management, strategic execution, and cross-functional leadership within a product-driven, technology organization .
- Proven ability to lead large-scale, multi-team, enterprise-level programs with direct impact on business growth.
- Extensive experience working with Product, Engineering, and Business teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
- Deep expertise in Agile, SAFe, Lean, and other enterprise frameworks .
- Strong ability to drive executive communication, influence strategic decisions, and manage C-level stakeholders .
- Advanced proficiency in program management tools (JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, etc.) .
- Preferred: PMP, SAFe, Lean Portfolio Management, PgMP or equivalent certifications.

Success Metrics
- Program Execution: % of enterprise programs delivered on time, within budget, and aligned with strategic goals.
- Business Impact: Measurable contributions to revenue growth, operational efficiency, and product innovation .
- Stakeholder & Executive Satisfaction: Positive feedback from leadership and cross-functional partners.
- Process & Agile Maturity: Continuous improvement in Agile adoption, cycle times, and efficiency .

jobs.title: Clean Energy Infrastructure Investment Manager
jobs.description:
Nuveen is the investment management arm of TIAA. It is one of the largest global asset managers with specialist knowledge across a wide array of asset classes, including fixed income, equities and alternatives. Nuveen is driven not only by the independent investment processes across the firm, but also the insights, risk management, analytics and other tools and resources a truly world-class platform provides. As a global asset manager, our mission is to work in partnership with our clients to create outcome-focused solutions to help them secure their financial future. For more information about the firm please visit our website at www.Nuveen.com

Overview of the Role:
The South Korea Investment Manager  will be the ultimate responsible for the origination, acquisition and divestment execution, and financing of renewable energy assets, including solar PV, onshore and offshore wind, battery storage, and renewable energy development platforms in South Korea.  They will oversee all activities and act as the central contact point for internal and external stakeholders when it comes to renewable energy investments and divestments in South Korea. The ideal candidate must have direct experience in originating and executing renewable energy transaction in South Korea.
The role offers potential for an attractive career path in clean energy as further funds with international and local mandates will be rolled out in coming years.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Conduct market and competition analysis and establish strategy for the deployment of capital in renewable energy investments in solar, wind (on and off-shore) and storage in South Korea.
- Manage the origination and execution of South Korean clean energy investments (acquisitions, mergers, project finance and divestures) in projects, joint ventures and development platforms leading a small internal team, and external advisors.
- Oversee the production of financial models for renewable energy generation projects/assets.
- Supervise preparation of and defend investments proposals in the Investment Committee.
- Network and manage relationships with South Korean co-investors – investments may range from minority stakes alongside local investor to 100% owned deals.
- Manage working relationships with external advisors (developers, lawyers, technical advisors, debt providers, EPC contractors, etc) in South Korea.
- Attract third party debt funding and Lead negotiation of key economic aspect of investments with counterparties (lending banks, EPC, developers etc.).
- Oversee the operations of development platforms acquired or established by Nuveen.
- Ensure the efficient delivery of projects in development and construction using past experience in EPC, bank documentation preparation, legal documentation.
- Act as Board Member or Director of investee companies, monitor and review of the investments in the portfolio in South Korea.
- Management accounts of portfolio’s assets.
- Support in liaising with renewable energy organisations, NGOs, utility companies and local authorities, etc
- Follow market trends in the clean energy sector in South Korea(regulatory framework, tariffs, country targets, etc).
- Manage the administrative tasks of the South Korean office (premises, hiring, etc)..

Qualifications & Experience Required
- Min 5-10 years relevant working experience in South Korea.
- Strong project finance background in power energy from origination to closing.
- Experience in evaluating renewable energy development projects and platforms. Exposure to Joint Development Agreement with developers
- Corporate finance transaction experience (from origination to execution) in the renewable energy sector.
- Relevant experience of power industry required.
- Experience in the renewable energy sector is a prerequisite, with a strong knowledge of the South Korean renewable energy market and players, in order to understand implications of market trends and draw conclusions for appropriate actions. Experience in leading and directing small teams of investment professionals and asset managers.
- Native Korean speaker and fluent in English required.

Competencies Required
- A strong academic background is required.
- Preferably, well recognised professional designation in finance, investments or engineering
- Sound and solid financial toolkit (building models, analysing financial statements, performing valuations, development or construction, structuring deals).
-  Native in Korean is required in order to interact with acquired/prospective companies, regulators and
- investors and to analyse data.
- A strategic approach, sound business judgment and a strong analytical and entrepreneurial mind-set
- Excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Team player with the ability to develop trusting and open relationships with other employees.

Additional Information

This role requires no regulatory designation.

jobs.title: Treasury Analyst II - Registered
jobs.description:
Treasury Analyst II - FINRA
The Treasury Analyst II Registered supports the cash management and liquidity strategy of the enterprise by performing treasury activities in an accurate and timely manner. Working independently under general supervision, this job performs and reviews cash flow monitoring and reporting as well as financial transaction and status reporting. This job also supports the financial risk management department in the collection, validation and maintenance of data needed to perform financial analysis as required by corporate policies.

Key Responsibilities and Duties - Analyzes and interprets financial data, modeling forward-looking cash flows, and developing cash management, investment, and risk mitigation strategies that support execution of the company’s liquidity management strategy and stress testing process.

- Compiles, analyzes and presents data to help Treasurer and management team understand implications of current economic environment to ongoing treasury operations.

- Manages daily flow of funds and transactions (e.g., daily cash requirements, cash receipts and payments, financial obligations, debt covenants, investment closings, etc.) to execute the company’s global cash management strategy.

- Responsible for supporting the company’s technology and banking strategy including evaluation of new systems, products, and services; ensuring efficient banking structures and accurate maintenance of accounts to support global operations with direct responsibility for management of the department’s governance program requirements associated with cash and banking.

- Prepares daily cash and liquidity management related activities, including required reports, metrics, and ad hoc cash and liquidity management analysis, support the preparation of the long-term liquidity forecast, and provides daily support for Corporate Treasury deliverables and reports, including excess/shortfall cash positions to short term traders, bank deposit allocations, or borrowing recommendations to Corporate Treasury Management for approval and coordinates with the organization’s chief investment office to execute and manage daily activities that achieve the objectives of the company’s spread lending program.

jobs.title: Director Brokerage Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The Brokerage Operations Manager supervises the clearance, settlement, and reconciliation of the organization's trades and positions on behalf of trade desks across the organization. This job manages a team that works closely with traders, finance, compliance, brokers and custodians and customers to ensure timely settlement of trades, accuracy of books and records and avoidance of unanticipated risk to both the organization and its customers. This job also ensures that all trade reporting requirements are followed and properly documented.

Key Responsibilities and Duties - Understands and mitigates risk associated with late settlement of cash and securities transactions including market penalties, buy-ins, and claims.

- Performs adequate due diligence to completely resolve all issues, in a timely manner, in order to avoid any financial or reputational impact.

- Evaluates and improves existing operational processes and maintain up-to-date procedures to reduce risk, increase efficiency, and support regulatory requirements and business initiatives.

- Signs off on all required clearance and settlement reports and documentation certifying that information is complete and accurate.

- Ensures that trade corrections have been properly processed in a timely manner.

- Manages performance of team through regular, timely feedback as well as the formal performance review process to ensure delivery of exceptional performance, engagement, motivation and development of team.

- Oversees and may administer complex trade executions and direct trades to outside custodians.

- Approves the delegation of large trades to outside brokers and follows up as necessary.

- Reviews suspicious/erroneous orders that have been escalated by team members and takes the appropriate action to resolve the issue.

- Reviews and reconciles reports to ensure trades have been executed and booked correctly.

Educational Requirements - University (Degree) Preferred

Work Experience - 5+ Years Required; 7+ Years Preferred

FINRA Registrations - SRC Indicator: Series 7; Series 63; Series 24

Physical Requirements - Physical Requirements: Sedentary Work

Career Level
8PL

The Brokerage Operations Manager job is responsible for leading a multi-site team that provides operational support to TIAA Brokerage clients.
- Lead team responsible for processing transactions for Brokerage clients.
- Responsible for all aspects of performance management, coaching and mentoring.
- Manage day-to-day activities to ensure client requests are completed correctly and in a timely manner.
- Manages performance of team through regular, timely feedback as well as the formal performance review process to ensure delivery of exceptional performance, engagement, motivation and development of team.
- Stay current on updates to the Pershing system and changes that impact the team.
- Drive continuous improvement efforts to improve quality, efficiency, and the client experience.
- Serve as subject matter expert on Brokerage Operations processes and participate in projects as needed.
- Build sound relationships across the enterprise to enable business partner support and close alignment with business objectives and firm risk appetite.

Required Qualifications
- 5 years of broker dealer experience

Preferred Qualifications
- 7+ years of broker dealer operations experience
- Prior experience working at a trading desk
- Prior people management experience
- Leadership experience in a highly regulated environment
- Proactive and able to prioritize competing tasks

Adaptability, Collaboration, Communication, Conflict Management, Continuous Improvement Mindset, Critical Thinking, Detail-Oriented, Financial Risk Management, Prioritizes Effectively, Transaction Processing
